policy: Distinct choices are recorded once. Preserved failures and oracle mistakes are not themselves new trade-offs. This index is not a claim that private implementation ledgers have been publicly replayed.

entries.choice: Same-profile fresh manager entry with origin data retained
entries.benefit: Honors the available profile and avoids a new-profile setup burden.
entries.cost: Does not establish unused-profile default state; live-document loss remains an outcome, not an accepted preservation policy.

entries.choice: Bounded temporary capture-phase geometry observer
entries.benefit: Separates pre-activation movement from app saved-position restoration.
entries.cost: Adds transient listeners/read overhead and does not establish uninstrumented timing.

entries.choice: Lossless indexed/tagged file-byte comparison in offline review
entries.benefit: Compares all actual bytes across equivalent retained snapshot wrappers.
entries.cost: Does not claim literal wrapper serialization equality; every other field remains exact.

entries.choice: Self-contained captured-HTML parser for native audit
entries.benefit: Repeatable verification without adding a parser dependency.
entries.cost: Explicit native select handling is required and authority is limited to captured HTML.

entries.choice: Separate installed notices Load and later category actions
entries.benefit: Retains an explicit first-load and approval boundary.
entries.cost: Adds one owned action scope without changing the request/effect map.

entries.choice: Reuse the cleaned response-probe tab for local recovery
entries.benefit: Preserves exact form lineage and avoids another native form read.
entries.cost: Couples final tab closure to the later recovery run; closure is now independently reviewed.

entries.choice: Dispose the failed owned lifecycle context conservatively
entries.benefit: Ends the failed page without bypassing conservative interception controls.
entries.cost: Foregoes possible late terminal observation; disposal does not repair incomplete cleanup.

entries.choice: Publish no raw evidence; author a private incremental disposition first
entries.benefit: Keeps unresolved requirements visible while preventing copying of authenticated material.
entries.cost: This draft is not schema-3-verifier-ready or self-contained for replay; final companions and review remain required.

entries.choice: Combine the native before/during/after checks into one scheduled session cycle
entries.benefit: Limits shared-session interruption.
entries.cost: Requires coordinated human timing and the qualified response gate.

entries.choice: Use an ordinary preparation read as the native in-flight object

entries.choice: Restore the same member after the guest boundary

entries.benefit: Preserves native provenance without authored response fulfillment.

entries.cost: Complete per-case readback and final evidence-level integration remain separate work; these metadata inventories cannot qualify installed/native outcomes.

entries.choice: Compose actual source/state replacement with a separate identical installed startup
entries.benefit: Supplies the missing installed no-resend dimension without repeating the proven manager replacement.
entries.cost: Requires explicit candidate/seed/preferences/path/runtime relevance joins and permanently retains the original incomplete startup interval; it is not a one-run complete-pass claim.

entries.choice: Accept three expressly narrowed native evidence bases
entries.benefit: Avoids new native search/social/deletion effects while preserving actual historical observations.
entries.cost: Unobserved fresh native search/populated notice and original removal absence remain unproved.

entries.choice: Reuse clean retained root-build library module
entries.benefit: Avoids rebuilding userscript or editing generated comments.
entries.cost: New module/tarball identities and exact fresh consumer/replay evidence must remain distinct.

entries.choice: Copy known populated cache into private execution area
entries.benefit: Keeps bounded consumer retry offline without mutating user cache.
entries.cost: Temporary43MB copy is excluded from publication.

entries.choice: Preserve generic consumer recipe and add preparation note
entries.benefit: Keeps original receipts byte-for-byte.
entries.cost: Readers must distinguish suggested build command from actual no-build preparation.

entries.choice: Separate immutable historical outcomes from required current assessment cases
entries.benefit: Allows unchanged strict verifier to assess accepted compositions without rewriting history.
entries.cost: Explicit history links and original status visibility are essential.

entries.choice: Publish exact assertion/result and hashed primitive projections
entries.benefit: Retains all case provenance without copying raw request/source strings.
entries.cost: Private pointer map and exact full replay source are needed; hashes alone do not invent semantic readback.

entries.choice: Use exact original declaration-call excerpts for schema inspection
entries.benefit: Avoids false-sensitive helper-token rejection while retaining original declaration bytes and full source elsewhere.
entries.cost: Excerpts are not independently executable; source/call identities and original locations stay explicit.

entries.choice: Recognize one complete observed integer balance-hint grammar
entries.benefit: Ignores only proven volatile display data while preserving all other hints and order.
entries.cost: Other locales, units, grouped/signed/decimal or duplicated/missing hints remain conservative.

entries.choice: Keep immutable public hint shape and retained source/ownership
entries.benefit: Avoids migration or automatic fresh-form adoption.
entries.cost: Historical balance label is not a live affordability promise.

entries.choice: Leave affordability and actual debit validation to native authority
entries.benefit: Prevents a display hint from becoming spending/refund proof.
entries.cost: Even lower fresh balance may reach native rejection under existing uncertainty rules.

entries.choice: Use shared compatibility comparison for the narrow balance exception
entries.benefit: Keeps direct/draft/funded callers consistent.
entries.cost: Broader caller surface requires affected negative coverage.

entries.choice: Extend existing full-app funded fixture with optional hints/ordinary mode
entries.benefit: Avoids a divergent second model and retains independent source/packet/attachment readback.
entries.cost: Adds bounded fixture configuration.

entries.choice: Freeze installed request bodies/order from the reviewed captured model
entries.benefit: Avoids evolving server state and native fallthrough in controlled checks.
entries.cost: Adapter is revision-specific and requires reviewed updates when request contract changes.

entries.choice: Use dependency-minimal exact recovered controller bindings
entries.benefit: Preserves original behavior while avoiding unavailable unused eager factories.
entries.cost: Missing historical closure remains explicit; recovered bytes need exact provenance.

entries.choice: Rehearse real controller through offline owned transport
entries.benefit: Supports repeatable complete-app and cleanup checks without native effects.
entries.cost: Actual installed transport acknowledgements remain separate evidence.

entries.choice: Keep terminal UI observation in owned scope until actual timeout/completion
entries.benefit: Avoids premature quiet-scope completion during asynchronous UI work.
entries.cost: Rehearsal is slower.

entries.choice: Serialize browser observations opaquely and parse locally
entries.benefit: Preserves exact JSON key order through transport while keeping strict guards.
entries.cost: Adds local parse and string-valued raw observation handle.

entries.choice: Support exact observed JSON search-success envelope
entries.benefit: Retains structured search transport and fixes captured app POST behavior.
entries.cost: Adds narrow parser support; nativeHTML switch and general redirect framework are avoided.

entries.choice: Reject unknown search envelope/actor/action/URL and hybrid document shapes
entries.benefit: Avoids unsafe guesses and effectful retries.
entries.cost: Unobserved future variants remain visibly uncertain until evidenced.

entries.choice: Reuse existing search client/workspace ownership without new cancellation API
entries.benefit: Prevents late result replacement and duplicate effectful POST.
entries.cost: One bounded GET can finish after local navigation without updating the newer view.

entries.choice: Use isolated staged builds/test mirrors with explicit exact-source import
entries.benefit: Preserves frozen dist and avoids concurrent shared-source edits.
entries.cost: Requires pinned source import, disclosed path adjustments and later integration verification.

entries.choice: Pair exact private response replay with wholly authored public fixtures
entries.benefit: Preserves actual diagnostic response authority and public privacy.
entries.cost: Authoring lookup/control data cannot prove native service success; host evidence stays separate.

entries.choice: Compare visible native search titles using independent rendered text
entries.benefit: Distinguishes HTML whitespace rendering from data loss.
entries.cost: Raw JSON whitespace equality is deliberately not the UI oracle.

entries.choice: Use minimal wrapper content plus actual DOM Selection and mode switches for caret diagnosis
entries.benefit: Isolates causal mutation and avoids hidden-textarea oracle.
entries.cost: Minimal Latin case cannot replace rich/IME coverage and depends on browser selection support.

entries.choice: Instrument a private copied editor observer for causal diagnosis
entries.benefit: Identifies exact mutation boundary without product instrumentation.
entries.cost: Experimental bundle is broader than safe repair and never counted as release candidate.

entries.choice: Ignore only owned hide/spoiler root presentation-attribute mutations
entries.benefit: Preserves locale changes without global observer suppression.
entries.cost: Allowlist needs deliberate maintenance; unknown mutations remain observed.

entries.choice: Permit existing disabled-empty native representation under exact keyed comparison

entries.cost: Separate context-specific validation boundary remains necessary to reject state drift.

entries.choice: Reuse pinned dependencies with local writable cache and verified runtime

entries.cost: UI lock-install cleanliness is not proved by reuse; fresh consumer installation is separate.

entries.choice: Keep public API version stable for internal validation fixes

entries.cost: Exact new tarball identity and consumer evidence distinguish every implementation.

entries.choice: Use realm-independent Uint8Array byte-view branding in fixture bridge
entries.benefit: Admits equivalent foreign Uint8Array/Buffer views.
entries.cost: Other one-byte views and lookalike objects remain excluded.

entries.choice: Recognize one exact observed merged-reply envelope

entries.cost: Unobserved envelope variants may remain uncertain; no general merge parser.

entries.choice: Reuse existing immutable result/recovery schema for normalization proofs
entries.benefit: Avoids migration for merge/mention repairs.
entries.cost: Raw source/readback receipts explain envelope/mention conversion because result metadata has no dedicated discriminator.

entries.choice: Normalize empty default-page hint only in native callback parser
entries.benefit: Preserves strict manually supplied candidate validation.
entries.cost: Retains separate parser modes.

entries.choice: Apply native callback normalization in shared outcome parser

entries.cost: Narrow support affects both callers and needs affected coverage.

entries.choice: Replay exact edit callbacks against authored original targets
entries.benefit: Isolates captured parser failure without new send.
entries.cost: Does not reconstruct complete native account/precondition lifecycle.

entries.choice: Request native representation only for mention capability pre/post checks

entries.choice: Limit stored mention conversion support to direct new-thread publication

entries.choice: Share existing bounded reply expansion for mention confirmation

entries.choice: Validate recovered endpoint images through same-post unique association

entries.choice: Allow dormant native controls only in private read-snapshot validation
entries.benefit: Preserves complete recovered evidence without relaxing exported command checks.

entries.choice: Compare attachment membership independent of presentation order
entries.benefit: Preserves immutable arrays and all non-attachment metadata semantics.

entries.choice: Allow structurally empty table rows subject to logical grid validation

entries.choice: Honor defaultPrevented at shared navigation delegate

entries.choice: Preserve confirmed writing in separate live context for subsequent edit

entries.choice: Classify exact observed telemetry destination as finite named abort
entries.benefit: Allows deterministic owned navigation while retaining abort ledger.
entries.cost: Suppresses native telemetry and relies on endpoint-pattern provenance, not initiator proof.

entries.choice: Keep wrapper-order ledger alongside original forum ledger

entries.cost: Consumers must distinguish sequence systems and actual acknowledgement evidence.

entries.choice: Abort observed native board polling in synthetic scopes
entries.benefit: Isolates deterministic external responses.
entries.cost: Does not qualify native background traffic.

entries.choice: Require two matching binary protocol representations for controlled uploads
entries.benefit: Detects missing/corrupt byte transport.
entries.cost: Depends on observed bridge capability and fails closed when unavailable.

entries.choice: Use small finite authored reader model with strict single epoch
entries.benefit: Gives exact current-byte controlled coverage without private native response replay.

entries.choice: Record pane-relative and absolute geometry with existing bounded tolerance

entries.choice: Reuse exact historical authorities with separately counted fresh-document bootstrap
entries.benefit: Preserves comparable scope while aligning real setup ownership.
entries.cost: Extra bootstrap reads and historical labels are explicitly distinct from fixed case requests.

entries.choice: Detach controlled interception before actual reload and observe passive traffic
entries.benefit: Tests recovery without model replay and avoids stale controller use.
entries.cost: Real installed event capture/native resource differences retain separate authority.

entries.choice: Treat synthetic composition only as offline observer smoke
entries.benefit: Makes instrumentation repeatable.
entries.cost: Cannot establish genuine OS composition or click ordering.

entries.choice: Split idle notice observation into controller-owned bounded segments
entries.benefit: Measures actual longer idle window without widening controller time limit.
entries.cost: Both elapsed time and segment completion must be recorded.

entries.choice: Strengthen settled-directory preflight while preserving old scalar epoch contract
entries.benefit: Improves current setup and keeps reachable partial handles on failure.
entries.cost: Adds preflight work without rewriting old evidence.

entries.choice: Restrict exposed current adapters to named cases while retaining unreachable original branches
entries.benefit: Keeps semantic provenance and prevents unintended extra effects.
entries.cost: Included generic code is not evidence those branches executed.

entries.choice: Keep original authored pending text and explicit readable copy before discard
entries.benefit: Preserves exact source comparison and safe incompatible inspection.
entries.cost: Current identity comes from source hashes, not historical text labels; this is not manager replacement proof.

entries.choice: Use separate one-endpoint Response-stage diagnostic
entries.benefit: Preserves original Request-stage controller contract.
entries.cost: Adds private helper/protocol review and excludes concurrent Fetch ownership.

entries.choice: Inject lost acknowledgements only at external adapter boundary
entries.benefit: Makes cleanup failure cases deterministic after real operations.
entries.cost: Does not reproduce an actual bridge outage; abort/no-retry may leave uncertainty unresolved.

entries.choice: Combine compatible writing and pending specimen in one actual replacement
entries.benefit: Reduces repeated manager reinstalls.
entries.cost: Only the exact authored state/target is established, not all deterministic variants.

entries.choice: Accept historical native ordinary/draft/direct/favorite/listed-file evidence with current controlled/affected checks
entries.benefit: Uses existing independently read native effects without repeated mutations or spending.
entries.cost: Keeps each original source/runtime, failure and observer limit; does not prove fresh a3de dispatch or waive other native/provenance requirements.

entries.choice: Quit and relaunch Chrome with normal restoration and no reseeding
entries.benefit: Observes actual browser lifetime behavior without manufacturing recovered state.
entries.cost: Accepts browser-controlled recovery absence and disconnected startup; no recovered-writing or current a3de restart claim.

entries.choice: Use exact newly created disk file plus unique completed CDP download after high-level wait timeout
entries.benefit: Establishes actual saved bytes despite missing high-level event acknowledgement.
entries.cost: Requires unambiguous file/download identity and independent byte comparison; timeout remains recorded and is not silently converted into event success.

entries.choice: Reuse the same owned workflow tab only after confirmed full source/revision and saved recovery
entries.benefit: Avoids unnecessary context proliferation while keeping next authorized step tied to actual confirmed state.
entries.cost: Requires exact saved-state guard and separate operation/readback receipts; is distinct from preserving another live original context.

notReenumerated: Repeated use of private captured replay versus public fixtures, dependency-minimal recovery, opaque JSON transport, staged builds/dependency cache and unchanged-authority adapters is consolidated once above. Runtime failures/oracle corrections are preserved evidence, not automatically new technical choices.
acceptanceNote: Accepted native substitutions are explicit evidence-scope decisions, not native correctness proof. Final source review requires no mandatory code change.
provenanceLimits: Older reports refer to numbered P1–P13 and controlled-authoring-recipes.md. That original note is not present in the retained context directory. This consolidated ledger records choices recoverable from actual retained repair/preparation ledgers; it does not fabricate the absent numbered note or claim its exact contents.
The nonblocking duplicate-helper advisory is a final maintenance observation, not a newly performed refactor.
finalLedgerDisposition: Completed advisor review confirms80 known distinct retained choices after four additions. Missing numbered-note contents are not invented; optional source duplicate-helper maintenance advisory is stated separately once in root report.
